paper.title: Dual Twist Channel Angular Extrusion for Ultrafine-Grained Material Processing as an Advanced Severe Plastic Deformation Technique: A Finite Element Analysis
paper.text: Finite element analysis of a dual twist channel angular extrusion process using DEFORM-3D.
